_meta.title: Nearest Tree to Bird
_meta.subject: Nature / Distance
_meta.description: A bird lands in a meadow. The student picks which tree it should fly to first — the closest one.

question.text: The bird wants to rest in the nearest tree. Which tree should it fly to?
question.hint: Think about which tree is closest to where the bird is standing.

primary.questionOverride: Which tree is the bird closest to?
primary.hint: Look for the tree that is right next to the bird!

middle.hint: Measure how far each tree is from the bird.

high_school.questionOverride: Using Euclidean distance, identify the tree nearest to the bird's position (0.5, 0.65).

university.questionOverride: Given seeker position (0.5, 0.65) in a normalised coordinate space, compute the L2 norm to each target and select the argmin.
